text_block_list.text: <Sirius> was once again aiming for Spring Trophy—

As if to prove those words were no lie, 
Special Week continued to pour in effort.
To support her, only one thing filled mind: [Spring Tenno Sho].

However, for her, teammate seeking 
to make race special, drive to "Take Trophy" grew fiercer.
And then――

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in sunlight, Kyoto Racecourse！ 
Aiming for trophy's glory, 12 Uma Musume gather！

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Center of spotlight, as expected: 
last year's champion, Mejiro Bright！

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Challengers from "Golden Generation": 
Kikka Sho winner Seiun Sky, 
and Derby victor Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In this three-way clash, what outcome awaits, 
as packed stands watch with bated breath！？

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, give it everything! Just like with McQueen, 
we're expecting ultimate [Spring Tenno Sho]!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm plannin' on baggin' this race someday too！ 
So get out there and crank hype to MAX！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes！ I'll live up to everyone's expectations, desu！
(Diiiing……♪)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm？ Was that Spe's phone？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah！ Message from Suzuka-san！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's see…… 『I'll be cheering for you. Do your best, Spe-chin』……。 
……Spe-chin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Middle of night over there. 
Probably half-asleep and hit wrong key……。

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, frantically sending cheers while half-asleep—
she truly wished to convey feelings, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We'll…… cheer super hard too……！

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Black Bob-cut
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Special Week-san！

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl with Straight-cut Bangs
text_block_list.text: We believe you'll cross finish line first！

Training form was best so far. 
Keep confidence in self, results will follow.
choice_data_list: Show us you can take that trophy！
Show us you can take that trophy！

text_block_list.text:
Training form was best so far. 
Keep confidence in self, results will follow.
choice_data_list: Show us you can take that trophy！
Show us you can take that trophy！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Mother's dream, my dream, and everyone's support giving strength—
I will definitely win, desu!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Spe-chan. Haven't run together 
since 『Kikka Sho』, huh……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I took win back then. Let's see who takes it today……

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ……Look in your eyes changed again, huh……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, I carry lots of expectations today, desu！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ……Same holds true for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No matter opponent, I need only fulfill duty…… 
that is my resolve。

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yet prior, against Seiun Sky-sama…… and Special Week-sama before that, 
I tasted defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Once more, to both members of "Golden Generation", 
with utmost respect: I shall stand at apex today……！

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Can't really back down after hearing that~ 
Guess we settle this on track.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, with all our might……！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Just as I desire……！

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now, before 12 elite racers, 
curtain rises on grueling 3,200m battle！

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Will defending champion take victory! 
Or will "Golden Generation" Classic winner claim throne!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Uma Musume loaded in gates. 
『Spring Tenno Sho』――begins！
